configurations.description: Deprecated: use `otel.instrumentation.messaging.experimental.headers.included` instead. A comma-separated list of header names to capture as span attributes. It does not support glob patterns: an entry containing `*` or `?` is ignored with a warning, and every other entry is matched as a literal header name.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.messaging.experimental.capture-headers

configurations.description: A comma-separated list of message header name patterns to exclude from span attributes. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. Matching is case-sensitive. `?` matches one character and `*` matches zero or more characters. If included is not configured, all non-excluded headers are captured, which may expose sensitive information.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.messaging.experimental.headers.excluded

configurations.description: A comma-separated list of message header name patterns to capture as span attributes. Matching is case-sensitive. `?` matches one character and `*` matches zero or more characters.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.messaging.experimental.headers.included
